title.en: Slack (OAuth, Bring Your Own Slack App)

summary.zh-CN: Slack 官方远程 MCP 服务，可搜索消息与频道、读取频道与用户信息（本连接只申请读取权限，不能发送消息）。Slack 不支持动态客户端注册，需先自建 Slack 内部应用并开启 PKCE，在连接设置中填写其 client_id（形如 1234567890.1234567890），再由 Teloa 以 OAuth（PKCE，无客户端密钥）授权。
summary.en: Slack's official remote MCP service for searching messages and channels and reading channel and user info (this connector requests read-only scopes and cannot send messages). Slack does not support dynamic client registration: create your own internal Slack app with PKCE enabled, enter its client_id (like 1234567890.1234567890) in the connection settings, then Teloa authorizes via OAuth (PKCE, no client secret).

conditions.zh-CN: 需在 市场 > 连接 页由本人在浏览器中完成 OAuth 授权；服务器部署需在配置文件设置 oauth.publicCallbackUrl
conditions.en: The owner must complete OAuth authorization in a browser from Market > Connections; server deployments must set oauth.publicCallbackUrl in the config file

conditions.zh-CN: Slack 不支持动态客户端注册，且只允许内部应用或已上架应用使用 MCP：需自建内部应用、开启 PKCE、把 Teloa 的回调地址加入 Redirect URLs、添加上述用户 scope，并在连接设置填写 client_id
conditions.en: Slack does not support dynamic client registration and only internal or directory-published apps may use MCP: create an internal app, enable PKCE, add Teloa's callback URL to Redirect URLs, add the user scopes above, and enter its client_id in the connection settings

conditions.zh-CN: 开启 PKCE 后该应用成为公共客户端（不可撤销），刷新令牌 30 天过期
conditions.en: Enabling PKCE makes the app a public client (irreversible) and refresh tokens expire after 30 days

conditions.zh-CN: 只申请读取所需的最小用户 scope（search:read.public、channels:history、channels:read、users:read），不含 chat:write 等写权限；工具清单待实测：官方文档未列出工具标识，实测后按实际工具补充并复核 scope。官方 PKCE 示例用 localhost，127.0.0.1 回调是否按桌面回调处理尚未实测
conditions.en: Requests only the minimal read user scopes (search:read.public, channels:history, channels:read, users:read) and no write scopes such as chat:write; the tool list is pending testing: official docs do not list tool identifiers, so tools will be added and scopes rechecked after testing. Slack's PKCE example uses localhost and whether a 127.0.0.1 callback is treated as a desktop redirect has not been tested
